prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic warm indoor mirror portrait for an approved adult, preserving the short blonde waves, light phone, black lace-inspired styling, sofa, and table lamp.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult with short blonde hair in loose waves and minimal natural makeup, wearing an opaque black camisole or fitted top with subtle lace trim and secure black high-waisted shorts. Hold a light-colored smartphone covering the face.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing upright in a relaxed pose with one arm raised holding the phone, centered in a mirror selfie framed from head to upper thighs. Include a partially visible sofa and side table with a lit lamp in a tidy lived-in room. Vertical 3:4 framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm lamp light balanced with ambient room light, soft indoor shadows, natural skin texture, subtle film grain, calm domestic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-end smartphone mirror portrait, vertical 3:4, standard-wide lens, crisp subject with natural background softness, realistic reflection.
